## Problem

What user, policy, or evaluation failure does this change address?

## Change

What is the smallest relevant behavior change?

## Verification

- [ ] Unit tests pass.
- [ ] Deterministic policy evals pass.
- [ ] The installable skill validates when changed.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test or eval case.

## Trust boundary

Does this change how trusted state, disclosure permission, evidence, or source IDs are produced or consumed? If yes, describe the new assumption and its failure mode.
